metadata.description: Agent skills by aldhosutra. Both aldhosutra/supervise and aldhosutra/loopa publish this same marketplace, so adding either repo gives you every plugin.

plugins.name: supervise
plugins.description: Supervise other Claude Code or opencode sessions running in tmux until their goals are met — keep them moving, review what they produced, and escalate only what needs a human.

plugins.name: loopa
plugins.description: Loopa (read "lupa": forget hand-editing loops). Turn raw footage into many distinct short videos that loop seamlessly in picture and sound: music-first cyclic soundtrack, AI slow motion, 15 viral formats, Indonesian dubbing.
